parts.stem: Put these sentences in the correct order to explain why an object weighs more when it is on a high mountain.

items.value: So it will have less weight.
Since the gravitational force is acting toward the center of Earth
An object on a high mountain will be affected by less gravitational force
And the weight of an object is affected by the gravitational force

correct_answer: Since the gravitational force is acting toward the center of Earth
And the weight of an object is affected by the gravitational force
An object on a high mountain will be affected by less gravitational force
So it will have less weight.
